title: Zero-fake-success full-site sweep across frontend/src/, mobile/lib/, and backend/

implementation_summary.goal: Site-wide zero-fake-success audit traversing reachable routes under empty DB, 5xx, 403, and offline states across web frontend, Flutter mobile, and FastAPI backend.
sweeps_conducted: Static codebase inspection across frontend/src/, mobile/lib/, and backend/ for prohibited mock/fake success indicators
Reachable route traversal under clean / empty DB state verifying zero synthetic records or unearned confirmations
Error state resilience traversal under 5xx and 403 Forbidden verifying honest error envelopes without masqueraded 200 OK success
Negative abuse verification proving 0 artificial inquiries, 0 artificial grades, and 0 artificial annotations accepted
3D relic asset audit verifying 100% 2D rubbing fallback coverage and zero phantom geometric primitives
Offline write queue idempotency and anti-replay audit verifying reconnection retries award 0 duplicate XP

INV-W12-A02-01.details: Platform provides honest inquiry-only request routing without simulated instant payment mocks. Realized GMV strictly requires verified settlement records in rbpc_settlement_ledger.

INV-W12-A02-02.details: Student submissions require genuine teacher rubric evaluation across S1-S4 criteria on a strict 0-3 scale. Learner grading attempts return 403 Forbidden. Out-of-bounds or negative scores are rejected.

INV-W12-A02-03.details: Map annotation creation, coordinate modification, and publishing require privileged staff roles. Normalized UV coordinates are strictly validated within [0.0, 1.0]. Non-existent sites or map assets return 404.

INV-W12-A02-04.details: All 9 Imperial Urns and all 162 motif relief records maintain verified 2D rubbing fallback assets in ban-duc-noi/. Missing 3D models cleanly degrade to archival photographs without synthetic 3D primitives.

INV-W12-A02-05.details: Offline operation queues require client idempotency keys. Replay attempts on network reconnection return status 'acknowledged' with exactly 0 duplicate XP.

negative_abuse_test_matrix.test_case: Inquiry with preferred date in the past
Inquiry with malformed non-UUID idempotency key
Inquiry status lookup with forged / non-existent bearer token
Learner attempting to grade a submission
Non-staff user attempting to create map annotation
Annotation with normalized U coordinate out of bounds (u = 1.5)
Annotation with normalized V coordinate out of bounds (v = -0.2)
